leave_sick_days_001.answer: 5 days (State Personal Leave, which replaced traditional sick leave) plus 2 days Local Leave
leave_sick_days_001.evidence: each full-time employee is advanced a total of seven days of paid leave of which five are required by the state and two are provided by local policy.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: State Personal Leave ... given to all full-time employees at the rate of five days per year with no limit on accumulation.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Family Illness is listed as an acceptable use for Old State Sick Leave, Local Leave, and Extended Leave; State Personal Leave 'may be used for any reason.'

leave_personal_days_004.answer: 7 days total advanced annually (5 State Personal Leave + 2 Local Leave)
leave_personal_days_004.evidence: State Personal Leave ... is given to all full-time employees at the rate of five days per year ... Local Leave - currently given at the rate of two days per year ... Senate Bill 1 eliminated “Personal Business Days.”

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: May not be taken for discretionary reasons on days scheduled for state-mandated assessments; documentation may be required for absences over 5 consecutive days.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: This leave may not be taken for a discretionary reason on days scheduled for state-mandated assessments.
